subject: CharterPay: confirmation of availability impact, credit eligibility, and postmortem
messages:
From: Anita Singh <anita@charterpay.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.example.com
Cc: ops@charterpay.com
Date: 2028-10-21T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Service interruption during peak window — asking for confirmation and credit path

Hi Priyom,

We saw an availability regression affecting our checkout traffic between 2028-10-20 23:42 UTC and 2028-10-21 00:06 UTC (roughly 24 minutes). Multiple retries and increased latency caused a measurable drop in completed transactions. Our finance team is asking whether this window qualifies for an SLA credit and we need the official confirmation + a trace bundle for our audit.

Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood observed the same availability gap for CharterPay in us-west-2;
- If eligible, the next steps for submitting a claim and an estimated timeline for resolution/postmortem;
- A pointer for a raw telemetry bundle (traces/metrics) we can include in our internal postmortem.

We appreciate a quick confirmation — this is time-sensitive for our billing reconciliation.

Thanks,
Anita Singh
Sr. Ops Manager, CharterPay
Attachments: none

From: priyom_das@redwood.example.com
To: Anita Singh <anita@charterpay.com>
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.example.com, laura_bennett@redwood.example.com
Date: 2028-10-21T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Service interruption during peak window — asking for confirmation and credit path

Hi Anita — thanks for reaching out and I'm sorry you saw that impact. We are pulling initial telemetry now and I can confirm we're treating this as an availability incident for CharterPay's us-west-2 routing. Immediate actions:

- Confirmed observed window (per our ingress traces): 2028-10-20 23:41:57 UTC - 2028-10-21 00:06:13 UTC.
- Next step for credit: please complete the attached SLO claim form (slo-claim-form.pdf) and return it to me. Once we have the form and any customer-side logs you want included we will start formal eligibility adjudication.
- Raw bundle: we will attach a telemetry bundle (raw_traces_charterpay_20281021.zip) with ingress/egress traces and load balancer logs.

I'll loop in Diego to coordinate the bundle and Laura for any contractual questions on pro-rata credits. Expect the raw bundle within ~2 business hours. If you want a call to walk through the timing and the SLA language, I'm available today 2–4pm PT.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — priyom_das@redwood.example.com
Attachments: slo-claim-form.pdf (form), postmortem-invite.ics (tentative)

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.example.com
To: priyom_das@redwood.example.com
Cc: Anita Singh <anita@charterpay.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.example.com
Date: 2028-10-21T11:37:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Service interruption during peak window — raw bundle and quick notes

Priyom / Anita — forwarding the raw bundle and a quick telemetry summary.

Attachments: raw_traces_charterpay_20281021.zip (contains ingress traces, LB logs, sampling of KV cache metrics)

Summary notes (quick):
- Root cause: transient autoscaler mis-signal combined with an ephemeral scheduler lag on one shard; we saw a localized token-shed pattern that increased latency and caused 502/504 spikes.
- Impact: targeted to a subset of load-balanced instances serving CharterPay; not a full region outage.
- Mitigations applied: immediate shard restart and temporary scaling override at 00:08 UTC to restore headroom.

We'll include full trace annotations in the bundle. Diego

On Tue, Oct 21, 2028 at 10:02 AM priyom_das@redwood.example.com wrote:
> Hi Anita — thanks for reaching out and I'm sorry you saw that impact...
>

From: priyom_das@redwood.example.com
To: Anita Singh <anita@charterpay.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.example.com
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.example.com
Date: 2028-10-22T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: CharterPay SLA claim: eligibility path, timeline, and postmortem invite

Hi Anita / Laura,

Thank you — I have the completed slo-claim-form.pdf and Diego's bundle. Based on our initial adjudication and the telemetry in the attached bundle, this incident meets the technical criteria for an SLA review (partial availability within the SLO window). Next steps and timeline:

1) Eligibility review (today): internal review of traces and alignment with the contract's availability definition (target: same business day).
2) Credit calculation (1–3 business days): finance/legal will compute pro-rated credit per the contract. Laura — can you confirm whether we should apply the standard pro-rata or evaluate an exception?
3) Postmortem: we are scheduling a joint postmortem review with CharterPay engineering to walk through cause, mitigations, and longer-term actions. Proposed time: 2028-10-25 at 10:00 AM PT. I attached a calendar invite (postmortem-invite.ics).

Please confirm the proposed postmortem time or suggest alternatives. Also confirm whether you want Redwood to prepare a redacted timeline and remediation playbook in advance.

For transparency, I'm including the claim intake ticket we created: JIRA: INF-3421 and a Drive link to the bundle: https://drive.redwood.example.com/charterpay/2028-10-21/log-bundle

On the attachments:
- slo-claim-form.pdf (completed by CharterPay)
- raw_traces_charterpay_20281021.zip (pulled by Diego; contains trace indexes and logs)
- postmortem-invite.ics (calendar invite for 2028-10-25 10:00 AM PT)

Thanks — we'll keep this moving and I will update the ticket as we progress.

Best regards,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198
